findings.title: Early Ollama setup failure crashes its error handler
findings.reproduction: Fail private-directory preparation for ping, tags or delete, or throw while writing the delete payload, before any child process is admitted.
findings.root_cause: All three catch blocks read ProcessOwner, but initialization occurs after fallible setup within the try block.
findings.silent_failure: The error handler raises UnsetError before invoking the failure callback and retiring the auxiliary owner; existing tests only fail later at launch or polling.
findings.regression_test: ollama-early-setup-failure: every request returns its failure value once and retires its owner; a partially written delete payload is removed without launching curl. Both new tests fail before the fix and pass afterward.

findings.title: Identity hotstrings suppress real case and delimiter edits
findings.reproduction: Register literal abc to abc with case-insensitive matching and type ABC, or register a non-star identity mapping and complete it with a consumed space.
findings.root_cause: The winner no-op guard compares replacement to the registered trigger rather than actual typed text and removed framing.
findings.silent_failure: Matching returns no winner, so dispatch and metrics never observe the suppressed edit. The existing shared identity vector only covers exact lowercase identity.
findings.regression_test: hse-actual-noop: three behavioral regressions fail before the fix and pass after it, covering case normalization, delimiter consumption, and priority masking. A fourth test covers conformity and nonliteral effects.
